description.value: Big Way Hot Pot is a rapidly expanding self-serve hot pot chain with multiple BC locations, offering diners over 100 fresh ingredients and more than 18 broths and dry mixes to customize their own individual pot. The Coquitlam location on Barnet Highway sits within a busy retail complex and is part of a chain that has grown to span BC, Ontario, and California. Signature offerings include a slow-simmered Sichuan Mala broth and a collagen pork bone broth prepared fresh daily.
